name: CrewAI
description: Multi-agent framework whose CLI scaffolds and runs a crew of role-based agents that collaborate on a task.
whatItDoes: Developers define agents with roles and tasks, then run them as a crew that researches, writes and reports. The generated starter project runs end to end and writes a report file. Flows add event-driven control around crews.
howItWorks: The `crewai` CLI creates a project, installs dependencies with uv and runs the crew. Agents execute tasks sequentially or under a manager agent in the hierarchical process, calling tools such as web search.

requirements.name: uv
requirements.description: Used for dependency management and the CLI install

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Model provider key set in the project .env file

requirements.name: SERPER_API_KEY
requirements.description: Serper.dev key, needed only when web search is used
